guide_solution: (a) "Health is wealth," is a very well-known saying. (b) Everybody should realize this truth to lead a healthy and happy life. (c) If we follow the rules of health, we can maintain a healthy life. (d) One can keep oneself safe by following the rules of hygiene. (e) Immune system can be developed by taking a balanced diet and regular exercise.
